chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 610: Soul-Scouring the Ninefang Princess – The Five Treasures Sword Art’s True Origin
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning bargains with a princess of a fallen Chaos Kingdom. A soul-scouring reveals the Ninefang King’s power and the shocking truth behind the Five Treasures Sword Art.
og_title: The Prisoner’s Bargain – New Lore on the Ninefang Kingdom
og_description: Ji Ning trades mercy for knowledge and uncovers the terrifying scale of the Ninefang Chaos Kingdom
twitter_title: Ancient princess or deadly spy? Ji Ning’s soul-scouring changes everything we know
twitter_description: A single interrogation reveals the limits of power in the Desolate Era universe.

lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden divine ability that allows a cultivator to forcibly read the memories of another being, often causing permanent soul damage if resisted.
The lifespan of a Chaosworld; each cycle lasts trillions of years. Used as a unit of cosmic time.
A high-security prison designed to hold beings of immense power; its indestructible Heavenly Locks bind the truesoul.
A cultivated secret art that enhances a cultivator's natural allure to mentally suppress and distract opponents.
A legendary torture realm; exposure drives even immortal minds to madness.
A soul-binding vow sworn on one’s life; violation results in immediate soul annihilation.
A supreme sword technique surpassing the Heavenly Dao; revealed to be a cosmic treasure, not created by Daofather Fuju.
The cultivation tier of World Gods and Chaos Immortals; the minimum requirement to create techniques that transcend the Heavenly Dao.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Ji Ning place a soul imprint on Qianrou?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A soul imprint would hinder her enlightenment and cultivation growth, making her useless as a long-term tool. As a permanent prisoner, a soul-scouring was sufficient.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Qianrou trap the Second Prince?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She lured him into the Sea of Ten Thousand Torments, a legendary torture realm that drove him insane in just half an hour.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Ji Ning break the World Prison's chains?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Heavenly Locks bind the truesoul itself, not the body. Only a Chaos Immortal, a World God, or the Ninefang King's personal command talisman can break them.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Five Treasures Sword Art created by Daofather Fuju?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. Ji Ning's soul-scouring reveals that only World-level beings can create such techniques. Daofather Fuju likely found it in a hidden location and claimed authorship to conceal the source.
